messages:
maya: pushed an experimental per-endpoint perf card to the console branch. shows p50/p95/p99, throughput, error rate, and a tiny token-latency waterfall per bucket. trying to catch kernel-selection and KV-cache related p99 spikes. link: gitlab/redwood/console#perf-cards
dan: nice. can you paste the query/aggregation you used? want to see sampling and bucketization approach
maya: sure — simple rollup for now, we keep per-token events for 1h and roll to aggregates for 24h. query I used: ```sql
SELECT route AS endpoint,
  approx_percentile(lat_ms, 0.5) AS p50,
  approx_percentile(lat_ms, 0.95) AS p95,
  approx_percentile(lat_ms, 0.99) AS p99,
  count(*)/3600.0 AS tps,
  sum(is_error) AS errors
FROM token_events
WHERE block_ts >= now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY route
```
(we bucket tokens by position range: prefix, kv-hit, kv-miss, decode)
dan: bucket by kv-hit/miss is huge — curious how you mark kv-miss in the event stream
maya: we instrument runtime: when KV lookup yields miss we tag token event kv_miss=true and emit the KV lookup latency as separate field. then waterfall groups kv_miss tokens separately
jordan: FYI I saw a weekend p99 surge on /chat/complete that correlated with a kernel fallback (fp16->float) during quantized model rollout. maybe kernel selection is flipping under load
leo: do we have metric tying kernel-choice decisions to route slices? currently kernel telemetry is at node-level only
sophia: we do emit kernel_choice in the runtime sample but it's not surfaced in console. good call to link kernel_choice -> per-endpoint p99 so operators can see if selection logic causes spikes
maya: thinking: add small sparklines for kernel mix and a stacked bar for kv-hit vs kv-miss ratio next to p95/p99. also surface a tiny list of recent traces for p99 (just 3) so you can jump to full trace
dan: +1. for traces: we should store the seed prompt + kernel + kv flags to S3 for 72h. keep PII redaction in pipeline
ops-bot: reminder: any additional logging must pass cost review — estimated +8% egress for token-level traces if sample 1/100
jordan: maybe do adaptive sampling: increase trace sample rate for endpoints that exceed p95 thresholds or when kernel mix changes >10%
maya: implement plan: 1) expose kernel_choice & kv_hit fields in per-endpoint rollup (p95/p99 split by token bucket), 2) add adaptive trace sampling on p95 breach, 3) UI: kernel mix sparkline, kv-hit bar, trace thumbnails. I'll open PR with screenshots by EOD tomorrow. assigning to jordan for sampling server hooks
leo: I'll mock the dashboard card layout in Figma and share in #design once PR is up
sophia: can we add an optional per-route QPS-normalized p99? i.e., p99_adjusted = p99 * sqrt(max(1, qps/target_qps)) — helps compare busy vs quiet routes
dan: interesting metric. might be confusing — can we show both raw p99 and a normalized contextual indicator (arrow up/down)
maya: noted. will show raw numbers + contextual indicator tooltip explaining formula
jordan: I'll add a feature flag for adaptive sampling + cost cap, and emit a metric when sampling ramps so ops can alert if budget hit
infra-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: perf-cards/feature branch -> staging cluster. CI shows 2 failing flake8s in telemetry parser
maya: fixing lint now, will drop another patch. thanks all — will post PR link in this thread when ready :thumbsup:
